title: Security
subtitle: Vulnerable dependencies, code findings and leaked secrets across your repositories — and the switches that catch them.

scope.title: What gets scanned
scope.hint: Repositories you administer. Alerts and switches need admin rights.
scope.baselineHint: What every repo should have switched on (where GitHub offers it). Missing switches lower the grade.

sla.strictHint: Critical 3 d · high 14 d · medium 45 d · low 90 d
sla.standardHint: Critical 7 d · high 30 d · medium 90 d · low 180 d
sla.relaxedHint: Critical 30 d · high 90 d · medium 180 d · low 365 d

noTargets: No repositories you administer in this scope

empty.noAlertsGaps_other: But {{count}} repos are missing switches that would catch problems.
empty.noAlertsBody: Nothing open in any scanned repository.

overdue: Open longer than your fix-within time

dependabot_alerts.name: Dependabot alerts
dependabot_alerts.what: Warns when a dependency has a known vulnerability.

security_updates.name: Dependabot security updates
security_updates.what: Opens pull requests that bump vulnerable dependencies.

secret_scanning.name: Secret scanning
secret_scanning.what: Finds tokens and keys committed to the repository.

push_protection.name: Push protection
push_protection.what: Blocks pushes that contain a secret before it leaks.

private_reporting.name: Private vulnerability reporting
private_reporting.what: Lets people report vulnerabilities to you privately.

code_scanning.name: Code scanning (CodeQL)
code_scanning.what: Analyses your code for security bugs on every push.

group.secretAdvice: Treat this credential as compromised: revoke or rotate it where it was issued first, then resolve the alert as revoked. Removing it from the code doesn't remove it from history.
group.depAdvice: Update {{pkg}} to {{version}} or later in each repo below (or turn on security updates and let Dependabot open the pull requests).
group.depAdviceNoFix: There is no fixed version yet. Check the advisory for workarounds, or dismiss with a reason if you're not affected.
group.depAdviceBot: Security updates are on here, so Dependabot opens the pull request that upgrades {{pkg}} — review and merge it.

repo.featuresHint: Changes go through the queue with a dry run

why.needsGhas: Private repositories need GitHub Advanced Security for this.
why.notReadable: GitHub didn't report this setting (missing rights or not offered).

dismissDialog.secretWarn: Only use this if the secret really isn't a risk — a leaked credential should be revoked.

fix_started.label: A fix has already been started
fix_started.hint: You're on it — e.g. an update is in progress.

inaccurate.label: This alert is inaccurate
inaccurate.hint: The advisory doesn't apply to how the package is used here.

not_used.label: Vulnerable code is not used
not_used.hint: The affected part of the package isn't reachable.

tolerable_risk.label: Risk is tolerable
tolerable_risk.hint: The impact is acceptable for this project.

false_positive.label: False positive
false_positive.hint: Not actually a problem / not a real secret.

used_in_tests.label: Used in tests
used_in_tests.hint: Only test code or test data.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.hint: The credential has been revoked or rotated.

featuresDialog.title: Switch a feature on many repositories
featuresDialog.note: The dry run checks each repo first: unchanged ones are skipped, ones where GitHub doesn't offer the feature are marked blocked.

fix.someUnfixableLong_other: {{count}} alerts have no fixed version yet — the upgrade won't clear them.

fix.headline_other: Upgrade to {{version}} or later — clears {{count}} alerts
fix.updatesOff_one: Security updates are off in {{count}} of these repos.
fix.updatesOff_other: Security updates are off in {{count}} of these repos.
fix.turnOnUpdates: Let Dependabot open the pull requests
fix.botOff: security updates off — upgrade by hand

dependabot.title: Set up Dependabot version updates
dependabot.group: One pull request per ecosystem (grouped updates)
dependabot.detects: Each repository gets a config for what it contains: npm, Cargo, pip, Go, Maven, Gradle, Composer, Bundler, Docker, NuGet — every folder — plus GitHub Actions.
dependabot.note: Opens one pull request per repository with .github/dependabot.yml.
